title: Hot Wheels: Stunt Track Driver
summary: Stunt Track Driver is a video game developed by Semi Logic Entertainments and Good Chicken Games while being published by Mattel Media. It was released on October 15th, 1998 for Windows and Game Boy Color. This game is notable for being one of the first Hot Wheels games allowing you to race the cars, being based on the Track System sets.

title: Hot Wheels: Beat That!
summary: Hot Wheels: Beat That! is a racing video game released in September 2007 and based on the Hot Wheels toy line manufactured by Mattel. The game was developed by Eutechnyx and published by Activision.

title: Mystery Models
summary: 300px|rightMystery Models were released in early November 2011 across Wal-Mart stores in the United States. These vehicles came in foil packs similar to trading cards, as opposed to Mystery Cars which came on blister cards with blackened out bubbles. Codes on the back of the packs can be used to determine what model one would get.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed
summary: Hot Wheels Unleashed is a 2021 racing video game developed and published by Milestone. The game was released on 30 September 2021 for the Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, Microsoft Windows, Amazon Luna and Google Stadia. A sequel to this game, Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged, was released on 19 October 2023.
